d: The US Department of War's Defense Intelligence Agency has published an intelligence report called Challenges to Security in Space. In that report, Washington lists space-based threats from China, Russia, Iran and North Korea. The report has an image of a Chinese space plane that has been kept secret for years. The image of the Chinese space ship was taken by a commercial satellite operated by the American firm Maxar Technologies, now Called Vantor.
